blocks.text: This Service Level Agreement ("SLA") is attached to and made part of the {{parent_agreement_name}} dated {{parent_agreement_date}} between {{provider_name}} ("Service Provider") and {{customer_name}} ("Customer").
This SLA applies to the following services:

rows: Calculated as: (Total Minutes in Month — Downtime Minutes) / Total Minutes in Month × 100
Scheduled in advance with {{notice_hours}} hours notice.
No penalty for scheduled maintenance within the allowed window.
Measured from time incident is reported to time service is restored.
Service credit per below + root cause analysis.

Service is unavailable or severely degraded. Customer operations are blocked.

items: Service Provider will monitor service availability and performance continuously using {{monitoring_tool}}.
Service Provider will provide Customer with a monthly service report including: uptime percentage, performance metrics, incidents, and service credits earned.
Customer may request a copy of the monitoring data at any time.
Service Provider will conduct a quarterly service review meeting with Customer to review performance and discuss improvements.

blocks.text: If Service Provider fails to meet the service levels defined above, Customer is entitled to the following service credits, applied to the next invoice:

rows: P1 support ticket not responded to within target
P2 support ticket not resolved within target

blocks.text: To request a service credit, Customer must submit a written request within {{credit_request_window}} days of the end of the month in which the breach occurred. Service Provider will review and apply or deny the credit within {{credit_response_time}} days.
Total service credits in any month shall not exceed {{max_credit_cap}} of the monthly service fee. Service credits are the sole and exclusive remedy for service level breaches.

Service Provider is not liable for any failure to meet service levels caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including: natural disasters, acts of God, war, terrorism, riots, government orders, internet or telecommunications outages, attacks by third parties (including hackers and DDoS attacks), or failures of third-party services. Service Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to restore service as quickly as possible.

items: Customer will provide accurate and complete information needed for the services.
Customer will use the services in accordance with the documentation and acceptable use policy.
Customer will report issues promptly and provide necessary information for troubleshooting.
Customer will not engage in activities that degrade service performance or compromise security.

blocks.text: Service Provider will notify Customer of any planned changes to the services that may affect service levels at least {{change_notification}} in advance. Emergency changes required for security or critical bug fixes may be made with shorter notice.

This SLA remains in effect for the duration of the parent agreement. Either Party may terminate this SLA with {{sla_termination_notice}} days notice if the other Party materially breaches the SLA and fails to cure within {{sla_cure_period}} days.
This SLA is governed by the laws of {{governing_state}}.
